reasoning_content:
There's no CSP in nginx. The Android browser is loading the main page but NOT the JS files. But wait - looking at the log again:```
92.209.222.137 - - [10/May/2026:08:33:09 +0000] "GET / HTTP/2.0" 200 1243 "-" "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36..."
```

The response size is 1243 which is small - that's probably the debug HTML I deployed earlier (which is only about 700 bytes). But also - there's only a GET to / - no subsequent GET to assets!

The browser loads the HTML from cache (304) but doesn't load assets. Wait - looking more carefully:
- 08:33:09 - GET / - 200 1243 (my debug HTML)
- 08:33:10 - GET /favicon.ico - 200 1243 
- 08:33:15 - GET / - 304 0 (cached!)

So after initial load, everything is cached and browser doesn't re-fetch. 

The JS isn't being loaded at all - the module scripts are not being fetched!

This is very suspicious. Let me look more carefully at the Android request pattern. Maybe there's something with how modules are loaded.

Actually wait - looking at the earlier entry:
```
92.209.222.137 - - [10/May/2026:08:06:49 +0000] "GET / HTTP/2.0" 304 0
```

304 = Not Modified - content was cached! The browser never re-fetches!

The problem is the browser is caching the HTML and not fetching new requests. This could be because:
1. nginx is sending aggressive caching headers
2. The browser cache is too aggressive
